name: Lossless Scaling Status
description: Reports whether Lossless Scaling (a paid Steam app, App ID 993090) is installed and whether a '3DXChat' profile exists in its own settings. Chosen deliberately over an in-process/game-directory approach: it captures and reprocesses the game's rendered window entirely externally, via AI upscaling (LS1) and optional frame generation - zero files added to the game's own install, nothing for its anti-tamper systems to react to. This mod never writes anything and never purchases anything - it only reads status. Tuning the profile (or creating one) is a separate, explicitly-run script: bootstrap\Setup-LosslessScaling.ps1, which also opens the Steam store page if the app isn't owned yet, since only the user's own account can buy it.
author: 3DXModKit
